facts.text: Chantier Davie in Lévis holds an $11-billion contract to build six new Coast Guard icebreakers, creating nearly 5,000 jobs in the construction phase alone.
Davie has begun construction of the Polar Max polar icebreaker at its Lévis shipyard, a project expected to generate more than a thousand high-value jobs.
Desjardins Group, headquartered in Lévis, is Canada's largest financial cooperative with more than 44,000 employees.
Lévis has 14 industrial zones and parks where approximately 800 businesses are established, with land still available in Bernières, Lauzon, Pintendre and the Innoparc.
In 2025, industrial land sales in Lévis topped 1 million square feet and QScale kept its data centre project, which requires more than $1.1 billion in investment, on course.

overview: Lévis counted 149,683 residents in the 2021 Census, up 4.4 percent from 143,414 in 2016, slightly ahead of the Quebec average. Households are comfortable: the median total household income was $84,000 in 2020, and the city's 65,751 occupied dwellings are spread across 448.07 square kilometres of former towns on the south shore of the St. Lawrence.

Money flows from big anchors. Desjardins keeps its head office here, Chantier Davie is building icebreakers under an $11-billion federal contract, and about 800 businesses fill 14 industrial parks. For a local firm, that means well-paid households, a strong trades and supplier base, and customers spread thinly across a large territory.

byService.lead-generation: Lévis households earn a median of $84,000, so lead generation can pitch higher-value services, but the 448.07 square kilometre territory calls for campaigns split by sector such as Saint-Nicolas, Charny and Lauzon.
byService.seo: Because Lévis shares a media market with Quebec City across the river, SEO must claim Lévis-specific French keywords and neighbourhood pages rather than compete for generic capital-region terms.
byService.website-development: A Lévis website should present service areas by former municipality and load quickly for shipyard and Desjardins employees browsing on mobile between shifts.
byService.branding: In a city of roughly 150,000 people where Desjardins and Davie set the tone, Lévis branding works when it looks established and trustworthy rather than flashy.
